observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 82.» (L3) and «p. 83.» (L26) in the left margin, as on every even page.
body L29: «’l–qarnayn» is printed with a dash longer than the hyphens of the page.
body L30, L33: the letters of the references (d) and (e) are bold italic.
notes_left L8: a speck stands before «referuntur» and another over its u; neither is a sign.
notes_right L1: حاصته is printed without the dot of the khā' (the word for the anomaly, خاصّته); kept as printed.
body L26, L28: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXI) read «54,26, pro utemus l. utemur» and «54,28, pro quantitas l. argumentum»; the printed forms «utemus» and «quantitas» are kept.
notes_right L2: the emendanda read «54, adn. 10, pro quantitate l. argumento»; the printed «quantitate» is kept.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
